|COMPATIBILITY= {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}}, {{GameCategory|arma1|link= y}}, {{GameCategory|arma2|link= y}}, {{GameCategory|arma3|link= y}}

|DOWNLOAD= {{Link|link= http://store.steampowered.com/app/233800/|text= Part of Arma 3 Tools package on Steam}}

|DESCRIPTION= WavToLip is an application that generates a lip files (*.lip) from wav files (*.wav).

|NOTES= '''Usage:'''<br>
A lip file accompanies a sound file meant for spoken words in a mission. The file lip-syncs the mouth of the character to the spoken words in a sound file. It shares the same name of the sound file and must be in the same folder.<br>
<br>
'''Example:'''
* talking1.ogg
* talking1.lip
<br>
'''Known issues:'''<br>The tool cannot process files with spaces in the name or path. Files on the desktop cannot be process for most users because of this.

|COMMAND= WaveToLip.exe source
